source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check switch function about BIOS SPI Write protect
1.Make Switch to another side.
2. Power on system , negative to jumper function page check.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Switch to another side , systerm still can power onsuccessfully.
2. Switch need functionaly.
3. Switch to orginal side , system should not hang or create error log.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- not runnable by agent: this switch-function check for BIOS SPI Write protect (via the BIOS SPI Write protect (standalone, direct protect-state check)) requires physically moving the BIOS-SPI-write-protect jumper to the other side, powering on to the jumper-function page in BIOS to confirm the feature engages, then returning the switch and confirming the system powers on with no hang/error. Toggling the onboard jumper and reading the BIOS BIOS SPI Write protect (standalone, direct protect-state check) page is physical/Pre-OS work only a person at the machine can do.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: operator toggles the BIOS-SPI-write-protect jumper (BIOS SPI Write protect (standalone, direct protect-state check)), powers on, reads the BIOS jumper page, restores the switch, and confirms a clean power-on with no error log; agent cannot operate the motherboard jumper.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: physical/hardware operation at the machine - human only; agent must not attempt.

historical_reviews.deepseek: NO. Correctly identifies the jumper/pre-OS boundary but labels the page check a direct protect-state check without proving actual write protection.

original_test_intent: Verify that the physical BIOS SPI write-protect switch/jumper selects its documented firmware indication, preserves successful power-on and cleanly returns to normal after restoration, without using an unapproved BIOS write as a probe.
original_method: An engineer de-energizes the board as specified, moves the write-protect control to the approved alternate position, boots and visually records the BIOS jumper/function page or documented read-only state, restores the original position and verifies unchanged firmware identity and clean boot.
manual_activity: The board switch/jumper must be physically moved/restored and its pre-OS indication visually checked by an engineer. The source does not authorize an automated write test.
required_inputs: Exact board revision, jumper/switch designator, orientations and safe power state
Documented BIOS function page/read-only write-protect indication and meaning
Baseline BIOS/SPI firmware identity and unrelated security settings
KVM/OOB and owner-approved BIOS recovery path
Qualified operator, maintenance window and explicit no-write boundary
safety_requirements: Do not move the jumper energized or guess its alternate position.
Do not write, erase or flash production SPI merely to demonstrate write protection.
Protect firmware identity and recovery image/tool compatibility before the test.
Stop on flash/write prompt, firmware change, POST failure or inability to restore the original position; do not retry.
agent_execution_scope: Capture read-only BIOS/firmware identity, security state and management health before/after the physical test.
Prepare the position/page evidence checklist and organize operator media.
Verify no firmware change occurred and report clean-boot/tool observations separately from the engineer verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the board-specific no-write validation method and contingency recovery.
Move/observe/restore the physical SPI write-protect control.
Validate the page/state and clean boot and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its manual path is appropriate, but 'direct protect-state check' is an unsupported characterization unless the vendor specification defines that BIOS page as authoritative.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use a documented read-only protection-state query if available. Never add flashrom or vendor write commands solely to make the testcase appear stronger.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Alternate/original switch positions, BIOS page check, power-on/no-error criteria and 5/15-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: READ-ONLY VERIFICATION ONLY; RETAIN PHYSICAL SWITCH
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map both physical positions to vendor-documented protect-state indications, capture BIOS/KVM evidence and a read-only register/status report if officially supported, restore the switch and compare firmware identity plus boot health.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact board, SPI controller/flash, BIOS build and strap logic.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board, BIOS/BMC and any read-only diagnostic version.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner schematic/service manual and documented SPI write-protect state interface.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds non-destructive corroboration and firmware-identity checks without performing a write.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No destructive write-path coverage is claimed; that was never specified by the source.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Physical mapping and authoritative read-only state definition.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A BIOS page may validate strap detection but not every hardware write-protection layer.

project_override_considerations: A project may add a controlled sacrificial write test only as a separately approved method with target, image, backup and recovery. It cannot be silently folded into this physical switch/page case. Missing board specifics are readiness inputs, not permanent BLOCKED.
expected_evidence: Board/jumper map, state semantics, BIOS identity, recovery and explicit no-write authorization
Timestamped alternate-position and BIOS/read-only protection-state evidence
Proof no erase/write/flash occurred and firmware identity remained unchanged
Original position restored, normal POST/OS/BMC/SEL health and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently describes a switch-function/page check and clean restoration. It does not conflict by demanding an actual SPI write.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The physical inspection method is clear. Platform-specific mapping and authoritative state are readiness prerequisites, not permanent blockers.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retain human-only classification but remove its unsupported claim of direct write-protection proof.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agree with MANUAL ONLY and its prohibition on destructive extension.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates physical strap recognition from actual write-path coverage and records the limitation.

review_improvement: Avoids a hazardous flash attempt and prevents a page-only result from being overstated as end-to-end SPI protection, while preserving the exact source test.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source's core is a physical strap transition and BIOS observation, so it is MANUAL ONLY. Actual write protection cannot be inferred from the label, and adding a write would be unsafe scope expansion rather than modernization.
